name: Low Rank NeRF Approximation with ADMM
definition: Reduction of NeRF model size by decomposing fully connected layer weights $\mathbf{W}_i$ into Tensor Train (TT) format using Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) to solve the rank-constrained optimization problem.
summary: Low Rank NeRF Approximation with ADMM compresses Neural Radiance Fields by iteratively refining fully connected layer weights into Tensor Train format using ADMM to minimize reconstruction error.
